description: Test suite for Mattermost server configuration commands, including get, set, patch, reset, show, reload, migrate, and export commands, with extensive use of mocks and assertions.

methods.name: TestConfigGetCmd
methods.description: Unit tests for retrieving configuration values by key, including handling of different data types and error cases.

methods.name: TestConfigSetCmd
methods.description: Unit tests for setting configuration values by key, including various data types, error handling, and restricted paths.

methods.name: TestConfigPatchCmd
methods.description: Unit tests for patching configuration from JSON files, including success and failure scenarios.

methods.name: TestConfigResetCmd
methods.description: Unit tests for resetting configuration keys or sections, including error handling for non-existent keys.

methods.name: TestConfigShowCmd
methods.description: Tests for displaying current configuration, including error handling.

methods.name: TestConfigReloadCmd
methods.description: Tests for reloading configuration from the server, including success and failure cases.

methods.name: TestConfigMigrateCmd
methods.description: Tests for migrating configuration with and without the --local flag, including error handling.

methods.name: TestCloudRestricted
methods.description: Tests for determining if a config path is restricted in cloud environments.

methods.name: TestSetConfigValue
methods.description: Tests for setting specific config values programmatically based on path and arguments.
